evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/google-shared-drives.ts: CLM-196-RESIDENCY-ONBOARDING-HANDOFF attributes the recovered template to Jamie while rejecting repeated-use, scale, participant-outcome, and artist-work causality claims.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/google-shared-drives.ts: CLM-NYCAC-MULTI-ACTION-GUIDANCE-DRAFT preserves working-draft status, Jamie's reviewed revision, the later collaborator edit, and explicit exclusions for publication, distribution, audience action, and policy outcomes.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/google-shared-drives.ts: OBS-GDRIVE-CRS-REVISION-CREDIT and the revised CLM-CRS-COALITION-OPERATING-SYSTEM distinguish Jamie's maintenance from collaborators' distinct edits and underlying collective decisions.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/google-shared-drives.ts and docs/knowledge-bank/anti-claims.md: CLM-SBU-STYLE-GUIDE-HANDOFF-SEED remains dormant, credits the identity-system collaborator, and rejects completion, adoption, and Jamie authorship of the identity.

scripts/tests/knowledge-development-evals.test.mjs: all 21 focused tests passed, including draft, collaboration, held-research, evidence-path, and projection-boundary regressions; the deterministic runner reproduced the supplied fingerprint with zero validation errors.
findings: Jamie's direct actions are stated confidently, while collaborators, coalition actors, participants, and institutional outcomes generally retain distinct credit.

The active CLM-GDRIVE-PORTABLE-HANDOFF-PRACTICE projection says the artifacts let collaborators orient, act, and continue without exposing protected material. The observations establish intent, artifact structure, and safety controls—not collaborator use, continuation, or successful non-exposure.

The same umbrella claim and apps/www/src/data/proofs.ts use “public guidance” for an artifact whose specific claim correctly establishes only a working draft. These localized outcome and publication-state slippages prevent an exceptional score.
evals.recommended_next_move: Change the umbrella projection to design-intent language and call the NYCAC artifact an action-oriented guidance draft; retain the current collaborator credit, anti-claims, and execution, reuse, and publication research tasks.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx projects CLM-GDRIVE-PORTABLE-HANDOFF-PRACTICE and CLM-GDRIVE-ARCHIVE-OVERVIEW-WORKFLOW as concrete handoff and mixed-format archive practices rather than exposing the underlying Drive corpus.

apps/www/src/content/work/196-sunday-dinner.mdx and apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx project CLM-196-RESIDENCY-ONBOARDING-HANDOFF and CLM-NYCAC-MULTI-ACTION-GUIDANCE-DRAFT, giving hiring readers specific actions, intended users, and operating purposes.

docs/knowledge-bank/projects/google-shared-drives-production.md and docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md keep repeated residency use, NYCAC distribution, workflow execution, the style-guide seed, 96 unreviewed drives, photographs, and WOWList transition materials visible as prioritized research rather than public accomplishments.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/kc-town-hall-funding.ts and apps/www/src/content/work/kc-town-hall.mdx retain the candid unused-funds ending and separate Jamie's first-hand transition account from official records, transfer mechanics, private reasons, and causal inference.
Citation tests passed 9 of 9; knowledge-bank, public-safety, and route checks also passed.
findings: The candidate materially improves hiring-reader usefulness: it names a residency handoff, collaborator-edited civic draft, mixed-format archive workflow, and cross-project documentation practice instead of relying only on generic operations language.
The research queue is unusually disciplined and preserves high-value unresolved work without weakening it into vague prose or promoting it prematurely.

The active umbrella sentence overstates demonstrated usefulness and privacy performance, while “public guidance” blurs draft versus publication. Execution, adoption, and audience-use evidence remain open, so the hiring argument is strong but not exceptional.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep the four specific proof directions, but revise the umbrella copy to describe intended handoff value rather than measured collaborator outcomes and consistently label the NYCAC artifact as an unpublished working draft until RT-GDRIVE-NYCAC-GUIDANCE-PUBLICATION-USE succeeds.
